---
output: html_document
params:
  revision: null
  logo: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 4.8, fig.height = 2.2, dpi = 120)
r = params$revision
compact = identical(r$type, "ESSENTIEL")
```

```{r logo, out.width="10%", fig.align="left"}
if (nzchar(params$logo) && file.exists(params$logo)) knitr::include_graphics(params$logo)
```

# `r r$titre`

**`r eduschool::libelle_niveau(r$niveau_id)`**

`r r$description`

```{r blocs, results='asis'}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(r$blocs))) {
  b = r$blocs[i, ]
  cat("\n## ", b$titre, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (nzchar(b$contenu)) cat(b$contenu, "\n\n")
  if (nzchar(b$formule)) cat("$$", b$formule, "$$\n\n")
  if (nzchar(b$illustration_id)) {
    eduschool:::.dessiner_revision(b$illustration_id)
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```

```{r notions, results='asis'}
if (!compact && nrow(r$notions)) {
  cat("\n## Notions eduschool reliées\n\n")
  for (x in unique(r$notions$libelle)) if (!is.na(x) && nzchar(x)) cat("- ", x, "\n", sep = "")
}
```
